rules: An authoritative event, character, item, reward key, and target quantity are required for reward reconciliation.
Reward reconciliation preserves existing matching identities and creates only the explicit target deficit.
An authoritative cleanup key, lifecycle reason, and target quantity are required for cleanup.
Cleanup affects only matching character-owned event items in inventory, equipment, portable containers, or bank storage.
Cleanup ordering is deterministic by descending runtime instance ID so earlier identities are retained.
Explicit event_cleanup_protected metadata blocks cleanup and rolls back the complete mutation.
No event mapping, timing, or reward semantics are inferred from item names or event labels.
assumptions: Event orchestration supplies authoritative reward and cleanup mappings.
Stable deterministic ordering is Reforged compatibility infrastructure until native ordering is recovered.
safe_fallback: No grant or cleanup occurs without explicit authoritative identities and quantities; protected or invalid state fails atomically.
runtime_impact: Enables exact event reward, expiration, cancellation, completion, and reset item orchestration without duplicate or orphaned quantities.
character_save_impact: Event item metadata, quantities, and runtime identities are persisted through the ordinary item save model.
world_state_impact: None unless a future authoritative event mapping explicitly targets world-owned items.
